capabilities.declaration_note: Running here but not in the services declared to the PHC: add it to the declaration (PUT /phc/services)
capabilities.label: Pharmacy dispensing
capabilities.purpose: Medicines dispensed from the facility's own stock (otherwise prescriptions are printed for the patient to buy outside).

outstanding.label: Medicine batches with stock
outstanding.how: Use the stock while the service retires; bring ward stock back to the pharmacy; write off what is left with its reason (expiry, damage, or an adjustment saying where it went), or return it to its supplier for a credit note the accountant confirms (decisions 47, R1)

capabilities.label: Tests sent to partner laboratories
capabilities.purpose: Samples taken here and sent to a laboratory under an MOU (lab tests marked SendOut).

capabilities.label: In-house laboratory
capabilities.purpose: Tests done in the facility's own laboratory.

outstanding.label: Laboratory tests ordered and not yet published
outstanding.how: Enter and verify each result, or cancel a test that will not be done

capabilities.label: Imaging (X-ray, ultrasound, CT, MRI)
capabilities.purpose: Examinations done and reported in the facility.

capabilities.declaration_note: Running here but not in the services declared to the PHC: add it to the declaration (PUT /phc/services)
capabilities.label: Outpatient procedures
capabilities.purpose: Procedures done without admission (dressings, minor procedures), with their procedure notes.

operations.when: for a Procedure note with its procedure, not an admission's
for the procedure of an outpatient's Procedure note

capabilities.label: Inpatient care
capabilities.purpose: Admissions, beds, nursing, the medication chart and discharge (medicines come from the pharmacy when dispensing runs, otherwise from outside on printed prescriptions).

capabilities.declaration_note: Running here but not in the services declared to the PHC: add it to the declaration (PUT /phc/services)
capabilities.label: Emergency department
capabilities.purpose: The emergency register, triage by the hospital's algorithm, observation and departure. (Every profile gives first aid and refers: that is part of consultation.)

operations.when: for an emergency patient (source Emergency) without an open emergency visit
unless the patient has an open emergency visit

outstanding.label: Emergency patients who have not left
outstanding.how: Record each patient's departure: admitted, discharged, referred or left

capabilities.label: Operating theatre and anaesthesia
capabilities.purpose: Operations with the surgical record: pre-operative note, anaesthesia, safety checklist, recovery.

capabilities.label: Sterile supply (CSSD)
capabilities.purpose: Sterilizer loads, packs, issue and recall.

capabilities.declaration_note: Running here but not in the services declared to the PHC: add it to the declaration (PUT /phc/services)
capabilities.label: Blood transfusion
capabilities.purpose: The hospital blood bank and the bedside: units received from a licensed blood center or bank (or, for a II B or II C hospital without its own bank, under a contract), the storage log, compatibility tests, issue, the two-person bedside check, reactions, wastage and return. Donors and their blood are the blood_center service's.

capabilities.label: Blood center (donors and their blood)
capabilities.purpose: The hospital's own blood center under its PBTA licence (owner decision B1, decisions 48): donors registered once for life, the doctor's assessment and deferral, written consent, the collection, every donation's five screens and its group, components in quarantine, and their release into the blood bank's stock by two people. Distribution to other hospitals is not in this release.

capabilities.declaration_note: Running here but not in the services declared to the PHC: add it to the declaration (PUT /phc/services)
capabilities.label: Maternity and newborn care
capabilities.purpose: Obstetric risk assessments with the counselling (and the nutritional assessment in Category I and II A) and newborns registered as patients of their own, 'Baby of' the mother, with their own band; the hospital's labour register and the birth notification for the union council, never a certificate (owner decision M1). The list of high-risk cases and its notice are kept whether or not it runs.

capabilities.label: Home visits
capabilities.purpose: Care at the patient's home by the establishment's doctors or nurses (the clinic manual, indicator 32). Not Active is a valid policy too: the notice for display then says home visits are not provided.

capabilities.label: Preventive programmes
capabilities.purpose: Immunization, family planning, TB-DOTS, malaria and dengue control and the like, as their national programmes run them: the list displayed, each patient's enrolment and the services given (the clinic manual, indicator 26). Retired only once every enrolment is completed or transferred.
